brief.headline: LISTER REKLAME AS
brief.summary: LISTER REKLAME AS (organisation number 985073546) is a private limited company in reklamebyråvirksomhet (NACE 73.110), founded in 2002, with its registered business address in Lyngdal. On its verified website the company describes itself as: "Lister Reklame tilbyr foliering av biler og butikkvinduer, trykk på tøy, skilt, storformat print, design av markedsføringsmateriell, annonser, brosjyrer og nettsider". Leadership on the register: Mari-Ann Mydland (chief executive and chair of the board); 1 further board member; LISTA REGNSKAPSLAG AS as accountant. Scale: 1 registered workplace in Lyngdal. In its filed accounts for 2025, the company reported revenue of 3.6 m NOK, an operating result of 387,913 NOK and a net result of 322,236 NOK; calculated from those figures, that is an operating margin of 10.8% and an equity ratio of 66%. Filed company revenue was 3.6 m NOK in 2025, up 175,588 NOK (5.1%) from 3.4 m NOK in 2024. Online, it has a verified website at https://listerreklame.no/ and company-owned profiles on Facebook and Instagram. It can be contacted by email at post@listerreklame.no and by phone on 38 34 38 01. This is the first observation of the company, so no changes are reported yet. Not established from permitted sources: an employee count, whether it is hiring, dated company-published activity and independent news coverage.
